meta.title: Buyer enables Vendor Masking on a live RFQ event

plan.title: Enable Vendor Masking on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open an existing live RFQ event suitable for the masking workflow.

args.goal: open the live RFQ event's Actions menu, select Enable Vendor Masking, and stop when the event screen or Master QCS shows Vendor 1, Vendor 2, and subsequent vendor aliases instead of real vendor names

steps.note: Perform the unsupported masking action and verify the resulting masked vendor identities on screen.
Assert that the masked vendor alias is visibly rendered.
